title: Machine learning-based radiomics model: prognostic prediction and mechanism exploration in patients with endometrial cancer.
summary: A radiomics model predicted postoperative overall survival in endometrial cancer and linked its score to angiogenesis-related imaging and molecular findings, with prospective imaging and laboratory follow-up. The result is reported in Biomarker Research. The study does not establish generalization beyond its reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
